Any.description: Any value, which the slot's `any_of` narrows: `currentValue` is a number or the string `not measured`.
Any.title: Any

CalculationPeriod.description: The value of `calculationPeriod`: the window an indicator covers, never an entity of its own.

end.description: The last instant the window covers.

start.description: The first instant the window covers.

CalculationPeriod.title: CalculationPeriod

Entity.description: The root every NGSI-LD entity class specialises.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

Entity.title: Entity

KeyPerformanceIndicator.description: One computed indicator, registered from the helsinki-kpi space.

calculationFormula.description: How the value was computed, in words a reader can check the number against: the measure, the aggregation, the window and any divisor, such as `per km² of the district's own area`.

calculationPeriod.description: The window the value actually covers, as `{ start, end }` RFC 3339 instants. It is the window the pipeline used and not the one it was asked for, so the distance between `calculationPeriod.end` and `updatedAt` is how stale the source is.

computedBy.description: The Pipeline that computed it, as its URN.

currentValue.description: The number, with its unit on the Property as `unitCode`, a UN/CEFACT common code, and the instant it describes as `observedAt`. A window with no reading in it carries the string `not measured` instead of a number, and never a zero: a zero reads as a measurement (Development/10 §5).

derivedFrom.description: The Endpoint the sources were read through, as its URN. The endpoint and not the space: what an indicator could see is what that endpoint's policy let it see.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

name.description: The indicator's own name, equal to the `{localId}` of its id, so the territory is legible without parsing the URN.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

updatedAt.description: When the pipeline last ran, as an NGSI-LD DateTime. It is the run and not the window: an indicator whose source stopped moving keeps its window and gains a newer `updatedAt`, which is the visible fact that the source is static.

KeyPerformanceIndicator.title: KeyPerformanceIndicator

Vehicle.description: One HSL vehicle in service, registered from the helsinki space.

delay.description: Seconds behind the timetable, negative when ahead (HSL's dl with the sign turned).

fleetVehicleId.description: The operator and vehicle number HSL publishes, operator-vehicle.

heading.description: Compass heading of the vehicle, degrees clockwise from north.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

nextStop.description: The stop the vehicle stands at or comes to next, the URN of a GtfsStop of this space; HSL moves it on at each departure from or passing of a stop.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

occupancy.description: How full the vehicle is, in percent; HSL sends 0 (room) or 100 (full).

onRoute.description: The line the vehicle is running, the URN of a GtfsRoute of this space.

route.description: The HSL route id the vehicle is serving, as GTFS names it (2550, 1009, 31M1, 3001K).

transportMode.description: What serves the stop or runs the line.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

vehicleType.description: The Smart Data Models kind of vehicle - bus, tram, passengerVessel for a ferry, other for metro and train; transportMode names HSL's mode.

Vehicle.title: Vehicle
